name: Rapyd
note: Rating note: main sponsor of Maccabi Tel Aviv B.C. since July 2025 on a seven-year deal — the team plays as Maccabi Rapyd Tel Aviv and carries Rapyd on the front of the jersey and the front of the shorts. Rapyd (Rapyd Financial Network (2016) Ltd) is a private, founder-led company backed by venture funds (rapyd-ownership); no source names a state or state fund as controlling it, holding 5%+, or holding a board seat, and the shareholder register isn't public. No human-rights finding against the company by a court, regulator, UN body or major NGO was found (checked 2026-09-29). Proposed: none.
